name: Card Delivery and Replacement
definition: Queries about the delivery status, replacement, or ordering of physical or virtual cards.

name: Card Activation and Deactivation
definition: Requests for assistance with activating or deactivating cards.

name: Card Usage and Acceptance
definition: Questions about where and how cards can be used, including contactless payments and ATM usage.

name: Card Declines and Issues
definition: Inquiries about why a card was declined or issues with card transactions.

name: Lost or Stolen Cards
definition: Reports of lost or stolen cards and requests for account freezing.

name: Unauthorized Transactions
definition: Concerns about transactions that were not authorized by the account holder.

name: Top-Up Issues
definition: Problems related to topping up accounts, including failed or pending top-ups.

name: Transfers and Payments
definition: Issues and questions about money transfers, including delays, fees, and cancellations.

name: Identity Verification
definition: Questions and issues related to verifying identity for account access or transactions.

name: Account Closure
definition: Requests to close or delete accounts.

name: Currency Exchange
definition: Inquiries about currency exchange rates and options.

name: Fees and Charges
definition: Questions about fees or charges applied to transactions or accounts.

name: Refunds and Reversals
definition: Requests for refunds or reversals of transactions.

name: Account Details Update
definition: Requests to update personal or account details.

name: Security and Fraud
definition: Concerns about account security or potential fraud.

name: PIN and Passcode Issues
definition: Requests for assistance with PIN or passcode issues, including resets and unblocking.

name: App and Online Access
definition: Issues related to accessing the app or online account.

name: Miscellaneous
definition: Queries that do not fit into other categories.
